title: Quantum Preconditioning For Constrained Optimization Problems
summary: We study the effect of quantum preconditioning on constrained combinatorial optimization problems, focusing on balanced graph bi-partitioning. The proposed approach uses two-point correlations between decision variables derived from the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) to construct a modified objective function that is subsequently provided to mixed-integer programming (MIP) solvers.
